now_playing.title: Mutiny
now_playing.description: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

now_playing.title: Heart of the Beast
now_playing.description: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

now_playing.title: Avengers: Endgame
now_playing.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.

now_playing.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
now_playing.description: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

now_playing.title: The Shawshank Redemption
now_playing.description: Imprisoned in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the Shawshank prison, where he puts his accounting skills to work for an amoral warden. During his long stretch in prison, Dufresne comes to be admired by the other inmates -- including an older prisoner named Red -- for his integrity and unquenchable sense of hope.

now_playing.title: WALL·E
now_playing.description: After hundreds of years doing what he was built for, WALL•E— a robot designed to clean up the earth—discovers a new purpose in life when he meets a sleek search robot named EVE. EVE comes to realize that WALL•E has inadvertently stumbled upon the key to the planet's future, and races back to space to report to the humans. Meanwhile, WALL•E chases EVE across the galaxy and sets into motion one of the most imaginative adventures ever brought to the big screen.

now_playing.title: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-ups
now_playing.description: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

now_playing.title: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair
now_playing.originalTitle: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair
now_playing.description: A former assassin, known simply as The Bride, wakes from a coma four years after her jealous ex-lover Bill attempts to murder her on her wedding day. Fueled by an insatiable desire for revenge, she vows to get even with every person who contributed to the loss of her unborn child, her entire wedding party, and four years of her life.  After devising a hit list, The Bride sets off on her quest, enduring unspeakable injury and unscrupulous enemies.

now_playing.title: V
now_playing.description: In the early 1990s, this city of desire, once a land of opportunity, was plagued by rampant crime and a breakdown of order. Man Tsz-keung, a working-class man desperate to change his fate, meets flight attendant Lok Ka-yuen, and the two team up to rob a large sum of money. This success fuels Man Tsz-keung's madness, pushing him into a deeper power struggle with wealthy businessman Chan Fai-yin. Meanwhile, mainland police officer Qi Honggang and Hong Kong police officer Guan Suchen continue their investigation of Wan Ziqiang, leading to a joint operation between the two police forces, setting the stage for a clash between good and evil. This film is fictional.

now_playing.title: Hideaway: The Dossiers
now_playing.description: A secret archive documenting the earliest revolutionary work of the Chinese Communist Party—the "Central Archives"—was successfully protected through the resilience and sacrifices of its guardians (both Party members and non-members) amid the turmoil and bloodshed from 1931 to 1949.

now_playing.title: Out of the Past
now_playing.description: Wu Shuang, a house tester, checks into a foreclosed villa on a rainy night. Together with Nian Lun, an amateur blogger, they keep dealing with the "strange occurrences" inside the house and gradually piece together the truth behind the former homeowner’s family tragedy...

now_playing.title: The Old Fox
now_playing.description: A homicide, a massive outstanding debt, a short-selling scheme—it all stems from a seemingly unremarkable yet highly suspicious theft. Jing Youzheng, a police officer nearing retirement, senses something amiss; as the investigation deepens, every clue points toward Bian Juhan, Chairman of the Mingdian Group. The veteran officer relentlessly pursues the case and takes the offensive, while Chairman Bian launches a counterattack. What is the actual truth? Amidst this clash between good and evil, what kind of high-stakes drama will unfold between these two adversaries?

now_playing.title: Dunhuang Warriors
now_playing.description: During a time of unrest in Shazhou, a once-prosperous Tang Dynasty outpost now under Tibetan control, a rebellion led by Zhang Yichao sparks hope for liberation. As the conflict intensifies, a group of unlikely heroes—including a thief, a deserter, and a general’s daughter—unite to fight for their people’s freedom.

now_playing.title: Illegal intruder
now_playing.description: This film takes a high-profile serial murder case as the entry point, exposes the harms of online trust crisis and domestic violence, and criticizes the plight of women under the male gaze. Pan Lei's desperate counterattack, working with criminal police and psychological experts to solve the case, demonstrates that justice requires the combined power of rationality and empathy. Beethoven's "Fate" runs through the whole film, and the ending "Nirvana of Light" makes it clear that the courage to confront the evil of human nature is the redemption that cuts through darkness.

now_playing.title: The Great Skull
now_playing.description: Gu Liyan, on the verge of graduating from university, suddenly faced her father's death and had to assist her sharp-witted mother in navigating the tedious funeral arrangements. Unexpectedly, the 'Funeral Affairs Committee' secretly organized by her father before his death suddenly arrived at their doorstep... With unanticipated guests, absurd situations, and ridiculously dramatic events, the mother-daughter duo urgently needed to gather their strength to confront it all.

now_playing.title: Demon Agent
now_playing.description: The fantastical and magnificent city of Chang'an, a city woven with gears and mechanisms, is home to both humans and demons living side by side beneath its upturned eaves. Di Shao, a genius young man aspiring to become "Chang'an's Number One Detective," possesses exceptional crime-solving skills and a sharp tongue; while Asa, a rookie wolf demon constable, is formidable in martial arts yet kind-hearted. A bizarre murder case forces these two adversaries to team up, embarking on a hilarious and bickering detective journey. As clues point to the heart of the city, can this unreliable duo protect the joyful daily life of this fantastical city? And what earth-shattering secret lies hidden behind the bustling and prosperous Chang'an?

upcoming.title: 生化危机：爆发夜
upcoming.description: 奉命奔赴浣熊市的医疗速递员布莱恩，意外深陷全城失控的病毒浩劫。浣熊市彻底沦陷，异变怪物横行肆虐、嗜血猎捕，身陷末日绝境的他，能否在这场惊魂噩梦中突围求生，搏出一线生机？

upcoming.title: 野兽之心
upcoming.description: 一名前陆军特种部队士兵与他退役战犬在阿拉斯加深处遭遇坠机事故后，这对老搭档必须在环境严酷的极地荒野中相互扶持，为生存而战。

upcoming.title: 鲸口脱险
upcoming.description: 一场突如其来的意外，让他被巨鲸吞入腹中。受困于漆黑鲸腹之中，他仅剩 一小时氧气。在与时间赛跑、与恐惧正面交锋的同时，父亲留给他的技能，或许正是他逃出生天的唯一希望。

upcoming.title: 什么意思夫妇
upcoming.description: 沈默和天意是一对中年夫妻，正在经历婚姻的第三个七年之痒，锅碗瓢盆的碰撞，终于让积压许久的烦躁、嫌弃和失望彻底爆发，三十天的离婚冷静期，即将奏响他们婚姻的终曲。

upcoming.title: 神探之痕迹
upcoming.description: 凡是经过，皆有痕迹。刑事技术警察崔寻走过半个多世纪，与同事屡破大案，这位秉承着“为人民服务”初心的神探，不仅见证了公安事业的发展，更见证了新中国的崛起。

upcoming.title: 小猪佩奇·完美假期
upcoming.description: 当佩奇得知今年全家不会去度假时，她感到非常失落。然而一场突如其来的暴风雨，竟将她带到了遥远的中国！佩奇一路解锁奇妙冒险，直到与家人重逢，佩奇拥有了最完美的假期。

upcoming.title: 活色生香
upcoming.description: 年过半百，人生就活个洒脱。快60岁还爱“年上”的薛宝梅人民公园逛三逛，说是遇到soulmate，但叫的是宝贝还是保姆分不清，难顶！金钱主义的蒋芳芳本是只寻搭子今朝有酒今朝醉，却一头扎进黄昏年下恋被搭子阿宽“闪了腰”，触霉头！梁美心老公离世洋房在手，别人艳羡多金寡妇她却封心锁爱，走不脱！三姐妹的退休生活玩玩闹闹，就算人生没有保洁大姐闪婚亿万富翁的爽剧戏码，“老辈子”们也会用自己的方式把人生下半场，过得活色生香！

upcoming.title: 重生2
upcoming.description: 孩子遭人迫害的母亲希拉，与妹妹有相同遭遇的哥哥苏诚，联手查明孩子受害的真相。两人以命相搏为孩子伸张正义，也将罪恶与阴谋的冰山一点点拽出。身负痛苦的他们在这趟复仇之旅中慢慢获得重生....

upcoming.title: 侦战
upcoming.description: 一名嫌疑犯于东城警署羁押仓内离奇蒸发。探员“默子”（古天乐 饰）奋力缉捕搜索，依然零线索、零头绪。百思莫解之际，默子接到匪夷所思的消息，逃犯被揭发身处市区的警务处总部档案库之中。反锁的仓库里，潜犯胸膛中枪当场毙命。他究竟如何逃脱东城牢房，溜到总部的档案库，从一个“密室”抵达另一个“密室”？总部专家确认夺命9999子弹，源自默子的警枪，他因而成为最大嫌疑犯。潜犯的死因诡谲，背景错综复杂。默子被宿命错综摆弄，迎战敌我难分辣手奇案。

upcoming.title: 喂喂喂，足球队
upcoming.description: 2024年，全国盲人足球锦标赛上，出现了中国有史以来最年轻的一支队伍——新疆盲人足球队，平均年龄15岁。  两年前，他们还是新疆莎车县一所特殊学校里喜欢足球却踢不到的视障孩子。上海盲人足球队教练张健驱车千里来选拔，四个孩子第一次离开家乡。从上海回来后，他们萌生了一个念头：新疆，也可以有自己的盲人足球队。没有经费，没有场地，没有教练——这支草根队伍几度面临散掉。是孩子们一遍遍踢下去，让更多人最终看见了他们。磕磕绊绊之中，新疆第一支盲人足球队仓促成立，这群几乎没经历过系统性训练的娃娃，就这样被推上了全国赛场。

upcoming.title: 一个夜晚与三个夏天
upcoming.description: 桑吉在拉萨拍摄一部和童年有关的片子，彼时的她面临着创作上的迷茫，与同为藏戏编导的父亲隔阂也难以消弭。一次偶然的派对，桑吉遇见了她所拍摄故事中的原型人物拉姆，夜晚悄然逝去，弥散在记忆中的夏天逐渐有了全貌...

upcoming.title: 新大头儿子和小头爸爸之天眼系列：失控的第七天
upcoming.originalTitle: 新大头儿子和小头爸爸之天眼系列：失控的第七天
upcoming.description: 为了替小头爸爸出气整顿职场，大头儿子借助天眼的魔法瞬间长大，但是到失控的第七天，情况越发难以控制，大头儿子与天眼还会碰撞出怎样的火花？七天魔法将尽，他们又该如何收场？ 　　影片是《大头儿子和小头爸爸》与《天眼》两大国民级卡通联动。
